adds.title: ILGA-Europe Rainbow ranking reports - 2016, 2019, 2024
adds.summary: In 2026 Russia scored 2%, among the lowest in Europe, and maintains explicit bans and legal limitations that make legal gender recognition practically impossible, leaving trans people in Kabardino-Balkaria with no accessible self-determination procedure.

adds.title: Supreme Court of Russia ruling, November 2023 - 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist
adds.summary: In November 2023 the Supreme Court of Russia designated the 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist and banned its activities across Russia, making public display of LGBT symbols, advocacy, organizing, participation and funding punishable under extremism law by fines, detention and criminal imprisonment, exposing trans visitors in Kalmykia to arrest, fines and prosecution for visible identity expression, association or advocacy.
